items.text: It was reported last week that Anthopoulos said it was unlikely Schwellenbach would be ready in time for Opening Day as the righty recovers from a second elbow surgery in August to repair a fracture. Schwellenbach posted a 3.09 ERA, 0.97 WHIP and 108:18 K:BB through 110.2 innings for Atlanta in 2025.
